SELECT (CAST((SELECT SUM(amount_units) FROM events WHERE period='P2' AND event_kind NOT IN ('mint','burn')) AS REAL) - CAST((SELECT SUM(amount_units) FROM events WHERE period='P1' AND event_kind NOT IN ('mint','burn')) AS REAL)) / CAST((SELECT SUM(amount_units) FROM events WHERE period='P1' AND event_kind NOT IN ('mint','burn')) AS REAL) * 100.0
